newsitem.title: LATVIA: MARCH UNEMPLOYMENT STABLE AT 7.5 PCT.
newsitem.headline: MARCH UNEMPLOYMENT STABLE AT 7.5 PCT.

text.p: Latvia's unemployment rate in March was stable at 7.5 percent compared with the February jobless level, the statistics committee said on Tuesday.

The committee said in a statement that unemployement in Riga was 3.7 percent. The lowest unemployment level was in Ventspils at 3.2 percent while the highest was in the eastern town of Rezekne at 13.4 percent.
The region with the lowest unemployent was Ogre at 4.7 percent and Saldus at 4.8 percent while Riga region had unemployment of 5.3 percent.

The regions with the highest unemployment were all in the east of the country. Rezekne region had unemployment of 29.5 percent, Kraslavas 25.4 percent, Preilu at 22.8 percent and Balvu at 22.3 percent.
